findings.detail: golden-path-result.txt shows Backend: http://localhost:8080. The LAN port is 8787. The /api/network/info endpoint returning a non-localhost IP was never verified against the actual runtime port. Re-run the golden path against http://localhost:8787 and record the result.

findings.item: TypeScript check predates LAN frontend additions
findings.detail: frontend-ts-result.txt does not list src/api/network.ts, NetworkStatusBar.tsx, or the updated types/index.ts. The tsc --noEmit run predates those files. A fresh check should be run and recorded to confirm no type errors in the new LAN surface.

CorsConfig maps allowedOriginPatterns to /api/** only. File streaming (ShareController) is at /api/files/share/{token} which is covered. If any future cross-origin page issues a fetch against a path outside /api/**, CORS headers will be absent. Low risk today; worth noting for future expansion.

findings.item: IP override is session-scoped and not persisted
findings.detail: NetworkService.setIpOverride stores the selection in an AtomicReference. A backend restart resets it to auto-detect. The UI gives no indication that the selection is ephemeral. Documented in LAN-REPORT.md as a known limitation.
